reader_summary.headline: Today, another episode of Behind the Memo, in which Howard shed some light on themes from his most recent memo.
reader_summary.overview: Today, another episode of Behind the Memo, in which Howard shed some light on themes from his most recent memo. Here he is discussing what really matters with Oak Tree Senior Financial writer Anna Shamansky. So, Howard, this memo weaves together many themes, including several you've discussed in previous memos this year.

key_points.text: So what made you want to tie all of these ideas together in a new memo?
key_points.evidence_quote: So what made you want to tie all of these ideas together in a new memo?

key_points.text: Well, you'll recall that two memos ago, I guess it's three now, I wrote, I beg to differ.
key_points.evidence_quote: Well, you'll recall that two memos ago, I guess it's three now, I wrote, I beg to differ, and that was about the importance of diverging from the herd, if you want to have superior results.

key_points.text: And you'll recall that it ended talking about my remarks at our June 21st conference in London.
key_points.evidence_quote: And you'll recall that it ended talking about my remarks at our June 21st conference in London, and the fact that people were asking me about inflation, about interest rate increases, and about the recession that will result from the interest.

key_points.text: My thinking about it over lunch and coming back on stage and say, you know what, all that stuff was short term.
key_points.evidence_quote: My thinking about it over lunch and coming back on stage and say, you know what, all that stuff was short term, and that's not what matters.
